title: Pivotal coordinates and formula width
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on $\{-1,1\}^n$, and let $x$ be an input. The number of coordinates whose flip changes the formula's output, when its output at $x$ is $-1$, is at most the maximum number of literals in any term of $\varphi$, taking this maximum to be zero when there are no terms.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on the Boolean cube
$x$ is an input in the Boolean cube
